ideas.title: Following the Money in Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigation into the financial transactions and entities involved in Medicaid fraud cases
questions: What are the most common schemes used in Medicaid fraud?
How much money is lost to Medicaid fraud each year?
ideas.insight: This story would involve analyzing financial data and public records to identify patterns and trends in Medicaid fraud. It could also involve interviewing experts and whistleblowers to gain insight into the schemes used by fraudsters.
